episodes.name: Secret Origin of the Batwheels
episodes.overviewEn: When Batman, Robin, and Batgirl are captured, the Batcomputer brings the Bat-Vehicles to life. The newly-minted Batwheels must defend the Batcave and face off with the Legion of Zoom – all without Batman’s help!

episodes.name: Stop That Ducky!
episodes.overviewEn: After snagging an ultra-fuel-cell upgrade, Penguin's Ducky Boat suddenly becomes the fastest vehicle in Gotham City. Confident leader Bam must rally the Batwheels to stop the turbo-Ducky!

episodes.name: Buff's BFF
episodes.overviewEn: When Buff befriends Mr. Freeze's snowcrawler Snowy, the other Batwheels bristle at the thought of hanging out with a "bad guy... " so Buff sets out to change their minds.

episodes.name: Up in the Air
episodes.overviewEn: After he causes the Batwing to crash, Bam becomes obsessed with making it up to her during a high-stakes aerial mission against Penguin and his giant ducky blimp.

episodes.name: Bibi's Do-Over
episodes.overviewEn: Everyone is ecstatic when Bibi, Batgirl, and Robin capture Toyman and his Do-Over remote - except for Bibi, who failed to stick the landing on a big jump. Unwilling to accept her failure, Bibi uses Toyman's Do-Over remote until she perfects her jump!

episodes.name: Sidekicked to the Curb
episodes.overviewEn: When Bam is sent to take on Prank, Redbird is forced to hang back because The Joker's van is too dangerous! When Bam discovers that Redbird secretly tagged along, he's upset... until Redbird bails him out of a tight spot.

episodes.name: Keep Calm and Roll On
episodes.overviewEn: After Jestah's insults get the best of her, a short-tempered Bibi tries to not let the big-wheeled bully's words get to her so she can help Batgirl catch Harley.

episodes.name: Bam's Upgrade
episodes.overviewEn: Feeling neglected after being passed over on missions, Bam asks MOE to install experimental upgrades to curry Batman's favor. But, when Bam's new powers are stronger than he can control, Batman - and the mission - are suddenly in danger!

episodes.name: Redbird's Bogus Beach Day
episodes.overviewEn: Redbird gets excited when he learns that Batman and Robin are taking him and Bam for a drive up the coast! But when the Joker and his van Prank show up unexpectedly and ruin Redbird's beach day plans, Bam helps him realize that even though things didn't go exactly as planned, they still had a great day!

episodes.name: Cave Sweet Cave
episodes.overviewEn: After the Joker floods the Batcave, the Batwheels evacuate and relocate to a nearby parking garage. As they adapt to their temporary home, they learn important lessons about family and making the most of what you have.

episodes.name: Scaredy-Bat
episodes.overviewEn: When Batman refuses to engage Joker in a race, Prank goads Bam into a rematch. Can Bam learn to not give in to the bully's dares and take the high road?

episodes.name: Riddle Me This
episodes.overviewEn: After struggling to solve a riddle from Riddler's helicopter Quizz, Redbird must learn to speak up and share his ideas with the Batwheels if they hope to figure out the villain's true scheme.

episodes.name: Zoomsday
episodes.overviewEn: The Legion of Zoom is tired of always losing. They decide to take a page from the Batwheels and try using teamwork in order to pull off a daring heist. But will they be able to work together?

episodes.name: Rev and Let Rev
episodes.overviewEn: Redbird sacrifices his stealth muffler tech to sound as loud as the other Batwheels but his modifications backfire when Robin needs his stealthy skills to catch the elusive Catwoman!

episodes.name: Batcomputer for a Day
episodes.overviewEn: When Batcomputer shuts down for a system update, the other Batwheels must take over for her while aiding Batman in a battle against Harley Quinn.

episodes.name: Grass Is Greener
episodes.overviewEn: MOE wants to know what it's like to be a member of the Batwheels, but the bot gets more than he bargained for when Bam invites him along for an exciting mission to stop Poison Ivy.

episodes.name: Holidays on Ice
episodes.overviewEn: Frustrated by the Batwheels' holiday distractions, Batwing decides to "go solo" to thwart Mr. Freeze's evil Christmas-time plot. But Batwing soon realizes how hard it is to stop Mr. Freeze on her own!

episodes.name: Bam's Clawful Mistake
episodes.overviewEn: Bam brings Catwoman's Catmobile, Kitty, to life so the Batwheels can have even teams for their game of "Bat-Ball," but the Kitty "Kitty" is too wild to be contained, despite Bam's best attempts to convince her to play along.

episodes.name: Harley Did It
episodes.overviewEn: Everyone assumes that Harley Quinn is the culprit in a recent burglary. But as Batman and Bam pursue Harley, Bibi and Redbird begin to suspect that she may actually be innocent.

episodes.name: Buff in a China Shop
episodes.overviewEn: Buff trains with Batwing to improve his gracefulness and uses her lessons on a delicate mission against the Riddler.

episodes.name: A Tale of Two Bibis
episodes.overviewEn: Badcomputer captures Bibi and disguises Jestah to take her place with the Batwheels so that Jestah can steal the Batcomputer's motherboard. Can Bibi get free in time to unmask the imposter and save the day?

episodes.name: Batty Race
episodes.overviewEn: When the Legion of Zoom plan to cheat their way to winning the Gotham Grand Prix, the Batwheels zoom into action to emsure the race is won the right way, fair and square !

episodes.name: When You're A Jet
episodes.overviewEn: Green Arrow and his Arrowplane, Goldie, come to help Batman take on the Riddler. Batwing is so happy to have another flying vehicle around that she brings Goldie to life and the two become BFFs. But when Goldie eventually has to leave, Batwing learns that saying goodbye doesn't always mean forever!

episodes.name: Ride Along
episodes.overviewEn: After Kitty the Catmobile saves Bam when he's in a tight spot, Bam decides to take her on a ride along patrol in the hopes of recruiting her as a Batwheel if he can convince her to stop playing long enough to focus on their mission!

episodes.name: Wheels Just Wanna Have Fun
episodes.overviewEn: Bibi wishes she could live a rule-free life like Jestah, so she decides to only focus on having fun instead. But when her actions put Batgirl in danger, Bibi must put the fun aside to stop Harley and save her hero.

episodes.name: Tough Buff Blues
episodes.overviewEn: After he takes down Riddler with an impressive wheel slam move, the Batwheels give Buff the nickname "Tough Buff." But Buff abruptly bristles at the name, leading the Batwheels to realize that it's not okay to call your friends nicknames that they don't like.

episodes.name: Wheel Side Story
episodes.overviewEn: After being zapped by Penguin's Songinator ray, the Batwheels find themselves only able to communicate through song! They'll need to learn to harmonize as a team to defeat the musical prankster.

episodes.name: Ace in the Hole
episodes.overviewEn: When a group of alley dogs, aided by a heroic stray, are saved from Catwoman by kind-hearted Buff, he brings them all back to live in the Batcave, unbeknownst to the rest of the Bat-Family.

episodes.name: Mechanic Panic
episodes.overviewEn: When Jestah injures herself preparing for an extreme sports competition with the other Zoomers, Bibi helps her overcome her fear of going to the mechanic so she can heal up in time to compete.

episodes.name: Improvise My Ride
episodes.overviewEn: When Buff's trusty winch is knocked out of action by Poison Ivy, he must learn to improvise and come up with creative solutions on the fly.

episodes.name: Dynamic Du-Oh-No
episodes.overviewEn: When Snowy and Jestah team up to execute a mysterious plan involving rare freeze-berries, Batwing and Buff pair up to take on the dastardly duo, but Batwing decides to carry out the mission herself, putting both her and Buff at risk.

episodes.name: To the Batmobile!
episodes.overviewEn: When all of the Batwheels (except for Bam) mysteriously disappear, Bam enlists the help of A.D.A.M, the original Batmobile, to help save his friends. Along the way, Bam comes to appreciate the old-school mobile's different crimefighting style as they team up to take on the Legion of Zoom.

episodes.name: The Dark Night
episodes.overviewEn: Much to everyone's surprise, Bam is secretly afraid of the dark. When Poison Ivy knocks out all the power in Gotham, Bam must conquer his fears to stop her.

episodes.name: License to Joke
episodes.overviewEn: When Redbird tries his hand at espionage as "V-8, the Super-Spy", he quickly realizes he's gotten in over his head, so Redbird teams up with Bibi to save the Amusement Mile from Dr. Spy!

episodes.name: Bibi's Bad Day
episodes.overviewEn: Bibi has a terrible no-good day after she keeps messing up and lets Joker get away. She doesn't think he can help Batgirl anymore, but a "bad today" doesn't mean it'll be a "bad tomorrow."

episodes.name: A Jet Out of Water
episodes.overviewEn: After refusing to practice with her new underwater mode, Batwing is unable to save Batman from Penguin's sunken ship trap. The Batwheels must help Wing practice her submersible skills before she can save the day.

episodes.name: Batty Body Swap
episodes.overviewEn: After agreeing to swap motherboards and change bodies, the Batwheels have to quickly learn to "drive a mile in each other's wheels" in time to stop the approaching Legion of Zoom!

episodes.name: Nightbike
episodes.overviewEn: Bibi has some competition with Nightwing’s motorcycle, Nightbike. These stunt bikes will need to learn that they’re better when they work together.

episodes.name: Bat-Light Blow-Out
episodes.overviewEn: When Ducky and Quizz steal the Bat-Signal’s one-of-a-kind lightbulb, Bam and Batwing must find a way to restore the legendary light so Batman knows when Gotham needs him.

episodes.name: Kitty's Sleepover
episodes.overviewEn: Kitty is staying over at the Batcave for a sleepover, but getting her to lie down for a catnap is no easy task.

episodes.name: Mission: Stuffed Animal
episodes.overviewEn: When Redbird takes one of Buff's stuffed animals without asking, Red enlists Bam to help him make a daring rescue.

episodes.name: Follow the Bouncing Bam
episodes.overviewEn: When Bam is covered in Bounce X goo during a chase with Prank, he must learn to embrace and use his newfound bouncing abilities to his advantage.

episodes.name: Big Rig Bam
episodes.overviewEn: Bam must learn to adapt and try something new as he's tasked to dive the Bat Big Rig all the way to Star City, while the Legion of Zoom chases after him.

episodes.name: Air-Show Don't Tell
episodes.overviewEn: Batwing and Goldie secretly decide to participate in the Gotham Air-Show, but when Batman needs their help, they must choose between winning the competition and their responsibilities to fight crime.

episodes.name: Monster Truck Amok
episodes.overviewEn: Grundy, a giant monster truck, causes chaos as he stomps around Gotham and creates a mess. He's too powerful for the Batwheels to stop, but Buff finds a friendly solution to end the city shaking shenanigans.

episodes.name: Razzle Dazzle Frazzle
episodes.overviewEn: When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover!

episodes.name: Multi-MOE
episodes.overviewEn: To ease the burden on MOE, the Batwheels use his duplicating machine to make copies of their repair bot, but the Batcave is soon overrun when the machine breaks!

episodes.name: The Ulti-Bat Rises
episodes.overviewEn: When the Legion of Zoom gains control of the Batcave's giant T-Rex, MOE creates a giant Bat-robot to stop the marauding dinosaur.

episodes.name: A T-Rexcellent Adventure
episodes.overviewEn: Super-genius villain Egghead is on the loose, planning to use Gotham Museum's famed giant egg to cook up a record-breaking breakfast.

episodes.name: Bats in Show
episodes.overviewEn: Gotham's annual dog show is tonight, and Harley plans to compete for the prized "Best in Show" ribbon.

episodes.name: The Gotham Guardians
episodes.overviewEn: Bam must lead a new super vehicle team after the Legion of Zoom traps the rest of the Batwheels in the Batcave.

episodes.name: Save the Bat Dance for Me
episodes.overviewEn: Redbird is convinced that nobody likes his eccentric dance moves, but it's up to the rambunctious rally car to dance his way to victory.

episodes.name: Nightbike's Noisy Night
episodes.overviewEn: After Nightbike reveals that he's afraid of loud noises, the Batwheels help him overcome his fear.

episodes.name: Bite-Sized Buff
episodes.overviewEn: Feeling insecure about his size after a game of Hide-and-Seek, Buff uses the shrink belt belonging to The Atom.

episodes.name: Redbird-O-Flage
episodes.overviewEn: Redbird struggles to stop Poison Ivy's diabolical schemes because he wants to be in the spotlight.

episodes.name: Pumpkin Panic
episodes.overviewEn: On Halloween Night, Poison Ivy brings all the pumpkins to life, creating an army of Snack-O-Lanterns that are eating all the candy.

episodes.name: The Wizard of Bats
episodes.overviewEn: Bibi enters the world of The Wizard of Oz, where she meets familiar vehicle friends and goes on an amazing quest to see the wizard himself!

episodes.name: The Great Christmas Caper
episodes.overviewEn: When Santa's sleigh is damaged, the Batwheels must help Santa deliver presents to the children of Gotham.

episodes.name: The Batgirlmobile
episodes.overviewEn: With Bibi in need of repairs, Batgirl takes Bam out for a spin to stop Mr. Freeze's latest icy crime spree.

episodes.name: Music Meister Mayhem
episodes.overviewEn: Music Meister steals the singing voices of all the people in Gotham, and bashful Buff must gain the confidence in his own voice.

episodes.name: Batwing and the Nets
episodes.overviewEn: When Batwing's favorite Bat-Net gets ripped during a chase with Riddler, she must learn to let go of her old net.

episodes.name: Clay Date
episodes.overviewEn: Clayface, Gotham City's messiest villain, arrives to cause trouble during Gotham's annual Clean Up Day.

episodes.name: Wish Upon a Car
episodes.overviewEn: Buff makes a wish on a magic artifact for the other Batwheels to be turned into monster trucks, just like him!

episodes.name: Bibi's Bat-Belt Blunder
episodes.overviewEn: Bibi just can't put down her new exciting video game, even when MOE needs her help packing Bam's utility belt for a mission.

episodes.name: Lend Me Your Volunteer
episodes.overviewEn: Buff tries to show Batwing how great it is to volunteer to help Gotham's needy, but the Legion of Zoom gets in the way.

episodes.name: Condiment Chaos!
episodes.overviewEn: Condiment King takes advantage of no Batwheels being on patrol to unleash a barrage of ketchup and mustard on an unsuspecting Gotham.

episodes.name: Bat-Blast-Off!
episodes.overviewEn: When King Tut steals an ancient artifact that makes his Carcophagus magically fast, MOE equips Bam with rocket boosters to catch the villain.

episodes.name: Flight of the Kitty
episodes.overviewEn: Now that Catwoman has equipped Kitty with wings, Batwing tries to teach the easily-distracted Kitty how to fly.

episodes.name: The Bestah Way
episodes.overviewEn: When Harley Quinn's Hyena goes missing, Bibi agrees to help Jestah look for her.

episodes.name: MOE Alone
episodes.overviewEn: A sneaky trick strands the Batwheels at the docks, clearing the way for a Batcave heist by the Legion of Zoom.

episodes.name: Bat-Buds Forever
episodes.overviewEn: Bibi and Batwing must work together to get past the Legion of Zoom in order to deliver a new giant screen to Batcomputer.

episodes.name: Banebuggy
episodes.overviewEn: The Batwheels take on a new vehicular villain who keeps growing bigger and bigger while learning that size doesn't always win the day.

episodes.name: Spiffledipped
episodes.overviewEn: While Green Lantern is having his spaceship repaired in the Batcave, the Batwheels want to play with his adorable alien pet.

episodes.name: Bibi and the Bad Seed
episodes.overviewEn: When Poison Ivy uses a rare pollen-spewing flower to put all of Gotham to sleep, it's up to Bibi to save her friends and save the day.

episodes.name: Gotham, We Have a Problem
episodes.overviewEn: When Badcomputer activates his own satellite and takes control of every computer on Earth, the Batwheels must launch into space to stop him!

episodes.name: Betterwheels
episodes.overviewEn: The Legion of Zoom wants to prove they're better than the Batwheels at doing good for Gotham, so they form their own super-team!

episodes.name: The Tumbler Begins
episodes.overviewEn: Batman calls on his newest, amazingly flexible vehicle -- the Tumbler -- to help him navigate the Joker's funhouse lair.

episodes.name: Sizzie Strong
episodes.overviewEn: Bibi and Batgirl are surprised to run into Harley and Jestah at their favorite popstar's concert, and now they've all got to team up to save the show!

episodes.name: Kitty Kong
episodes.overviewEn: When Kitty splashes in Ultra Grow-Gas, she grows enormous. Now, the Batwheels must keep her, and Gotham, safe until she shrinks back down to normal.

episodes.name: Sidecar Chaos
episodes.overviewEn: Bibi is excited to use her sidecar on a mission with Batman and Batgirl, but can she adjust to the bulky accessory in time to stop Joker and Harley?

episodes.name: Flight Night
episodes.overviewEn: Batwing borrows a device that will allow the other Batwheels to fly like her. But if it falls into the wrong hands, it could spell trouble for Gotham.

episodes.name: It's My Bat Birthday Too, Yeah
episodes.overviewEn: When the Batwheels celebrate their mutual birthdays together in the park, party games that should be fun start to go mysteriously wrong.

episodes.name: Batdraft
episodes.overviewEn: Batman, Buff, and Ace put their new firefighter training to the test when a magical fire breaks out in Poison Ivy's fortress.

episodes.name: Presto Change-o
episodes.overviewEn: Bibi and Batgirl team up with the fabulous magician of the Justice League, Zatana, and her amazing magic-using car, Presto.

episodes.name: Caped Crusader Caper
episodes.overviewEn: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar.

episodes.name: Aqua-Wheels
episodes.overviewEn: When Batman teams up with Aquaman to stop a sinister undersea plot, the Batwheels are excited to use their new cool underwater mode.

episodes.name: You Talkin' to Me?
episodes.overviewEn: Batman gets help from a mysterious, yet somehow familiar hero as he chases the villain Croc through the tunnels beneath Gotham City.

episodes.name: The Butler Did It
episodes.overviewEn: Batman calls on an old friend to lend MOE a hand in keeping the Batwheels clean and functional as they take on Condiment King.

episodes.name: A Purr-fect Pair
episodes.overviewEn: When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

episodes.name: Third Wheel
episodes.overviewEn: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. When Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever.

episodes.name: Skatin' Ace
episodes.overviewEn: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with help from Ace.

episodes.name: Bats of Clay
episodes.overviewEn: Clayface is back in town, and this time he may be too much, and too many, for the Batwheels to handle.

episodes.name: Double Trouble
episodes.overviewEn: The Batwheels tangle with a two-faced supervillain car named Dent, and with Bam out of town, it's up to Buff to lead the team.

episodes.name: Ski Blanket Bingo
episodes.overviewEn: When Mr. Freeze tries to turn Gotham Point Beach into his own personal ski resort, Redbird and Buff must find a way to stop him and save summer.

episodes.name: Holographic Heist
episodes.overviewEn: When Miss Kitka sneaks into the Batcave and steals a priceless diamond, Bam, Kitty and Ace chase her through the training arena's holographic city.

episodes.name: Bat-Babies
episodes.overviewEn: When the villainous Clock King turns Bat-heroes into babies, the Batwheels are charged with stopping him -- and keeping the Bat-Babies out of trouble.

episodes.name: Feline Flash Mob
episodes.overviewEn: The Batwheels team up with The Flash, scarlet speedster of the Justice League, in order to chase down an army of crime-committing cats.

episodes.name: Oh Crow You Don't
episodes.overviewEn: The Batwheels investigate a spooky mystery while camping out in the woods beyond Gotham.
